verses.text: Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
…for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God…
I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
“For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.”
Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
Know therefore that Yahweh your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments…
We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us, even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved…
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.
The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace
For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
…and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and he won’t do it? Or has he spoken, and he won’t make it good?
There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts. See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
…not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit…
He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
Nothing failed of any good thing which Yahweh had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.
Who may ascend to Yahweh’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place? He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.
We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
Blessed be Yahweh, who has given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he promised. There has not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.
Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly…
Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.
…rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer…
Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
…bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.
Examine me, Yahweh, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
…for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God; being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus…
Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.
“Yahweh is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.
Yahweh himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.
Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.
For his loving kindness is great toward us. Yahweh’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!
But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.
He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
…the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?
For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. Yahweh is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.
In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
Let your loving kindness be on us, Yahweh, since we have hoped in you.
Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another…
Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’
We love him, because he first loved us.
Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
For Yahweh’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.
Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.
A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.
…knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.
For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”
Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.
Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God…
For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.
For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.
Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace…
He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.
I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living. Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
…for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
“Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”

Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.
He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.
From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this…
Some of you were such, but you were washed. You were sanctified. You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.
For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.
A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way. Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.
In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
…throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ…
If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea, even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.

Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works, not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.
If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.
Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
When my father and my mother forsake me, then Yahweh will take me up.
Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.
Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
Yahweh, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.
For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light…
For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
…that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person…
Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.

If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God. Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand? But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us…
Arise, shine; for your light has come, and Yahweh’s glory has risen on you!
Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you!
Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance…
Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
…strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy…

The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound…
“For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says Yahweh who has mercy on you.
Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
…bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
“Come now, and let’s reason together,” says Yahweh: “Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool.”
But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.
…and Yahweh will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.
…so is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and it will prosper in the thing I sent it to do.
May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.
Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands. Your walls are continually before me.
Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.
Always rejoice. Pray without ceasing. In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.
We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair; pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed…
He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice.
For I, Yahweh, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.
Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy on him, to our God, for he will freely pardon.
Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.
This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil…
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
…but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior, because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”
Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.
For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory…
Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.
He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot. You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us…
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead…
For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.
…let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.

Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort, who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.
…looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
…looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ…
…that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world…
God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
“I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”
For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.
He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.
Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.
For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.
Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.
The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.
If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.
For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.
Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.
Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.
…who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love, in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.
Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.”
You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.
Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.
You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses…

Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour. Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before, I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.
Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.
But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
…casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.
As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to save many people alive, as is happening today.
…who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal…
What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.
He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
Tear your heart and not your garments, and turn to Yahweh, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and relents from sending calamity.
In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.
…while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.
Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?
The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’

…and refused to obey. They weren’t mindful of your wonders that you did among them, but hardened their neck, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage. But you are a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and didn’t forsake them.
And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
But as for me, I will look to Yahweh. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
…seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue…
Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
Yahweh passed by before him, and proclaimed, “Yahweh! Yahweh, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth…”
You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.
Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.
Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy…
See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?
Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
For the Lord will not cast off forever. For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.
…for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.
But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.
Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.
He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.
Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
Yahweh appeared of old to me, saying, “Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with loving kindness.”
Yahweh will fight for you, and you shall be still.
For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.
…but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!

The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed…
I will heal their waywardness. I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away from them.
Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy. Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.
Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord…
God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect.
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.
Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”

…and he said, “Listen, all Judah, and you inhabitants of Jerusalem, and you, King Jehoshaphat. Yahweh says to you, ‘Don’t be afraid, and don’t be dismayed because of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God’s.”
Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
…who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. Yahweh frees the prisoners.
I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

For Yahweh’s eyes run back and forth throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. You have done foolishly in this; for from now on you will have wars.
Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.
Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
…“teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.
Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yah, Yahweh, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.
…because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us, to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.

…may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth, and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.
He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”
How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!

You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

“No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in judgment. This is the heritage of Yahweh’s servants, and their righteousness is of me,” says Yahweh.
You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness…
The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.
The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own…
Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.
God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.
I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.
I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry. He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.
But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”
For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
Cast your burden on Yahweh and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.

For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but Yahweh looks at the heart.”
Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings…
He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you. For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness, that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
Therefore Yahweh will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on you, for Yahweh is a God of justice. Blessed are all those who wait for him.
But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.
This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
I will not die, but live, and declare Yah’s works.
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.
Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from? My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.
Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?
He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths. Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.
Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.
One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life, to see Yahweh’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.
For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.
Blessed be Yahweh, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle…
For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people. For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.”
The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God…
Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.
Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh.
I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for Yahweh sustains me.
Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.
…being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
